target.title: fix(auto-reply): skip transient preflight compaction failures instead of terminating Composer
target.body:
### What Problem This Solves
When preflight compaction fails due to transient provider or timeout errors, the Composer is permanently locked in a "terminated" state instead of letting the main reply attempt continue.

### Why This Change Was Made
`isPreflightCompactionSkipReason` only skipped "nothing useful to compact" cases. Timeout and provider errors were treated as hard failures, contradicting the comment that preflight compaction is a guardrail, not a hard dependency.

### User Impact
WebChat/Control UI sessions that hit the compaction threshold during a transient LLM failure no longer become unrecoverable; the reply continues and the user can retry or resend.

### Evidence
- Added regression tests in `src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory.test.ts` covering `timeout`, `provider_error_4xx`, and `provider_error_5xx`.
- Local run: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/auto-reply/reply/agent-runner-memory.test.ts` → 51 passed.
- `oxlint` on changed files → 0 warnings, 0 errors.

Fixes #100778
